Docket 1.3.156

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *Docket's engine stops when the app does.* If the app was closed in a way that skipped its normal shutdown, such as a
  crash or Force Quit, its background engine could keep running. It now watches the app and stops within a few seconds.
- *PDF reports work with screen readers.* Every PDF report Docket writes is now tagged: it has a language, its title, headings
  and paragraphs in reading order, tables with header cells, and a text description of the score dial and your logo. The
  pages look exactly as before.
- *"No advertising pixels installed" is a note, not a problem.* Its own advice says that if you run no paid campaigns there is
  nothing to do, yet it could rank above real problems. It now counts as a note.
- *On Windows, the app says "this computer".* A few lines, including the first screen, said "this Mac".
- *A first look at Public Site Check.* A new tab checks a public body's website and documents for accessibility problems
  against its ADA Title II date, and shows the problem counts and one problem in full. The full check is coming soon.
- *Open-source notices.* The licences of the open-source software inside Docket are now in the app and in `docket notices`.

99 checks across 13 areas.
